description: The plot illustrates the relationship between a numerical value on the x-axis and accuracy on the y-axis. The x-axis is labeled “Feedback Strength” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.91 to 0.98, with tick labels at intervals of 0.01. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2.  A blue line, marked with circle-shaped data points, begins at approximately 0.86 at a feedback strength of 0.91 and increases to approximately 0.93 at a feedback strength of 0.94, then decreases to approximately 0.91 at a feedback strength of 0.98. An orange line, marked with diamond-shaped data points, begins at approximately 0.64 at a feedback strength of 0.91 and decreases to approximately 0.22 at a feedback strength of 0.98. A green line, marked with triangle-shaped data points, begins at approximately 0.03 at a feedback strength of 0.91 and increases to approximately 0.73 at a feedback strength of 0.98. Each line includes vertical error bars at each data point, with varying lengths across the x-axis.
